description: Rothco’s Enhanced Large Molded Pepper Spray Holder is designed for public safety professionals who need reliable, durable gear on duty. Constructed from heavyweight denier ballistic material, this pepper spray holder provides exceptional durability and protection. The interior is lined with a high-density foam center and soft lining, ensuring your pepper spray canister is safeguarded against damage. With dimensions of 7 inches x 2 inches when closed and 6 inches x 2 inches when open, this pouch accommodates larger pepper spray canisters, including the Sabre Red Crossfire 3 oz. canister. The hook-and-loop closure allows for quick, one-handed access, giving you the ability to respond swiftly in critical situations. Designed to fit on duty belts up to 2 1/4 inches wide, the pepper spray holder is easy to secure and stays firmly in place, providing confidence and convenience for public safety personnel.
